completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-1: src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/translation.py exposes a StreamEventTranslator class with method translate(stream_part: StreamPart, context: BuildContext) -> PipelineEvent | None.
completion_promises.evidence: src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/translation.py exists (22162 bytes) and exports StreamEventTranslator. Method signature `def translate(self, stream_part: StreamPart, context: BuildContext) -> PipelineEvent | None` is exercised by tests/forge/lifecycle_bridge/test_translation.py::TestTranslatorSurface::test_class_is_importable and ::test_translate_signature — both PASSED in turn 3 re-run. The translator inspects stream_part.event, requires correlation_id from context, infers feature_id, extracts the AutobuildState snapshot under stream_mode='values', diffs against the per-feature_id prior snapshot, and dispatches to the appropriate typed payload constructor.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-2: The translator handles every documented StreamPart.event value the langgraph-runner sidecar emits during an autobuild run; unknown events return None and are logged at DEBUG (not WARNING - unknown events are routine during langgraph-api minor bumps).
completion_promises.evidence: translate() short-circuits to a logger.debug() + return None for any stream_part.event != 'values'. TestUnknownEventBehaviour::test_unknown_event_returns_none, ::test_unknown_event_logs_at_debug_not_warning (asserts NO records at WARNING+), and ::test_unknown_event_does_not_raise (parametrized over 'metadata', 'messages', 'updates', 'events', 'end', 'custom') all PASSED in turn 3 re-run. The DEBUG-not-WARNING rationale is documented in the module docstring (AC-2 paragraph) so future maintainers don't 'fix' it to WARNING during a langgraph-api bump.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-3: Each typed payload constructed by the translator carries correlation_id from BuildContext.correlation_id (no fallback; raises if missing).
completion_promises.evidence: _require_correlation_id() runs as the first line of translate() and raises MissingCorrelationIdError(ValueError) if BuildContext.correlation_id is missing or empty. There is no silent fallback. Every payload constructor either threads correlation_id= as a keyword argument (v2 payloads: BuildPausedPayload, BuildResumedPayload, BuildCancelledPayload, StageCompletePayload) or pairs the construction with attach_correlation_id_to_v1_payload() (v1 payloads: BuildStartedPayload, BuildCompletePayload, BuildFailedPayload — these models have ConfigDict(extra='ignore') so post-hoc attachment is the canonical pattern). TestCorrelationIdRequired::test_empty_correlation_id_raises and ::test_missing_correlation_id_message_mentions_field both PASSED.
